content:
diego: Heads-up 10: Cervello Clinics wants a weird billing plan for a 2.5yr dedicated commit. Asking for Net150 payment terms, 10% upfront first year, then monthly milestone invoices for deployment phases. Also asking for a 30% discount off our published reserved rate.

emma: oof Net150 is outlier. what's the total value and rationale?

diego: total ARR equivalent is $800k/year => ~$2M total over 30 months. their central finance only releases payments after regional approval rounds (slow). They want monthly invoices after onboarding milestones to align to approvals.

tara_finance: Net150 is long but the amount is material. need credit check, AR exposure calc, and proposed mitigations (higher upfront, payment bond, or third-party factoring). Also need to see the discount justification. 30% is steep for reserved commit.

diego: customer says they can't do >10% upfront due to budget rules. They offered a corporate guarantee letter from their parent nonprofit and a vendor reference.

@deal-desk-bot: Please provide: full legal name, billing contact, tax status, proposed invoice cadence, and mitigation plan for extended terms. Attach credit check when available.

diego: legal name: Cervello Clinics Cooperative; billing: ap@cervello.org; tax exempt: yes (nonprofit); mitigation: parent guarantee letter pending; willing to add late fees and step-in rights in contract.

harper_legal: we can add interest on late payments and require milestone acceptance criteria. For Net150 we should also include a revocation-of-service clause and a short cure period before termination. If theyre tax-exempt, confirm certificates.

tara_finance: exposure calculation: if invoice lag hits 150 days, peak receivable ~ $500k. Recommendation: two paths: A) Accept Net150 with parent guarantee + 20% upfront; B) Counter with Net90 + 15% upfront + 10% holdback until year-end reconciliation. I prefer B.

nina_csm: operationally, monthly milestone invoices are fine if we map milestones to SOW deliverables. CSM can own the acceptance checklist and signoffs per region.

sam_se: technical note 10: some milestones depend on integration with their EHR vendor; add 4-week buffer to milestones for vendor approval to avoid billing disputes.

emma: propose we present two options to customer: Option 1 (Net150 + parent guarantee + 20% upfront) Option 2 (Net90 + 15% upfront + 10% year-end holdback). Also offer a 10% discount (not 30%) tied to a 24-month commit instead of 30.

diego: customer pushed on 30%; they said benchmarks from competitors. we shouldn't give 30% without Deal Desk ok.

@deal-desk-bot: Recording exception: type=Payment Terms; requested_by=diego; customer=Cervello Clinics Cooperative; value=$2,000,000; term=30 months; options=["Net150 + parent guarantee + 20% upfront","Net90 + 15% upfront + 10% holdback"].

tara_finance: I can approve Option 2 (Net90 path) now. Option 1 requires signed parent guarantee and 20% upfront before I can sign. Also need completed credit and nonprofit tax docs.

harper_legal: i'll draft contract language for both options, include payment security, milestone acceptance, and cure periods.

emma: diego please send the two-option proposal to their procurement, cc finance & legal. @deal-desk-bot escalate to Deal Desk for formal sign-off.

diego: will send in next 2 hours. proposed invoice schedule below for clarity:

```
Total Contract Value (30 months): $2,000,000
Option 1 (Net150 + parent guarantee + 20% upfront):
  - Upfront payment: 20% = $400,000 at signature
  - Monthly milestone invoices: 25 x $64,000 each approx, Net150
Option 2 (Net90 + 15% upfront + 10% holdback):
  - Upfront payment: 15% = $300,000 at signature
  - Monthly invoices: 25 x ~$56,000, Net90
  - Year-end holdback: 10% = $200,000 payable after annual reconciliation
```

@deal-desk-bot: Escalation created: #DD-8823. SLA 48h.

tara_finance: I'll run the credit check and confirm if the parent guarantee text meets our standards by EOD.

harper_legal: will share redlines here once ready.

emma: thanks team. prefer Option 2 but keep Option 1 as fallback if parent guarantee is rock-solid.

diego: thanks all 10 will update after procurement reply.
